steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Initialize the Android project structures, establishing base directories and configurations for Edge Border Light.

steps.title: Define Manifest & Permissions
steps.description: Declare required permissions including SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE, specifying the overlay service in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Implement Custom Overlay View (BorderLightView)
steps.description: Create a custom View class utilizing SweepGradient and Matrix transformations to draw and animate continuous rotating gradients along the screen borders with customizable width and round corners.

steps.title: Develop Foreground Service (BorderLightService)
steps.description: Develop the Foreground Service responsible for adding and managing the custom BorderLightView inside the system WindowManager with precise overlay flags for touch click-through.

steps.title: Design Settings User Interface (activity_main.xml)
steps.description: Construct an intuitive settings UI using standard Android Widgets allowing adjustment of width, animation speed, corner radius, and color gradient patterns.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity logic (MainActivity.java)
steps.description: Build logic to request Draw Overlays and Notification permissions, save settings in SharedPreferences, and dynamically update the active BorderLightService.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Inspect all source code to ensure strictly traditional anonymous inner classes are used, avoiding Lambdas, streams, and newer Java language additions.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Check the AndroidManifest.xml to ensure proper xmlns:android declarations, package structure, activity configurations, and service properties.

steps.title: Final Review & Compilation Setup
steps.description: Review the global project configuration against the target JDK 17, Gradle 8.5, and AGP 8.3.2 compilation rules.

steps.title: Building Edge Border Light
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final high-performance native package.
